title: Charlotte | Effortless short-sleeve shirt for everyday wear
bodyHtml:
Get that relaxed, put-together look without thinking twice. This versatile shirt is designed to feel as good as it looks—soft against your skin, with a relaxed fit that skims your frame without clinging. Simple details and a timeless silhouette mean you'll reach for it season after season, whether you're running errands around Melbourne or settling in at home.

Why you'll love it

  • All-day comfort in a relaxed fit that suits every body
  • Short sleeves keep you cool through warm days and unpredictable weather
  • Flattering neckline adds a touch of polish to your casual style
  • Soft, breathable fabric that feels lovely to wear
  • Works just as well dressed down with jeans as it does layered over a tee
  • Easy to care for and built to last through countless washes
  • The kind of shirt you'll wonder how you ever lived without

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
